reading.restatement: This change adds code and pilot data for a CAP journey census feature (FR-990). The author ran three pilot reads of 30 CAPs each and committed the raw results (docs/census/cap-journey-pilot-2026-09-05.*). The code changes include fixes discovered during the pilot: demoting an enum leak, excluding a self-consumption directory, adding node-type consumer needles, deriving extend_to from journeys.yaml, adding a value_generic filter, and implementing tolerant evidence matching with kind recorded. The prompt was revised (revision 2) via scripts/author.sh to focus on end-user journeys and remove extend. The render.py file was split to keep tools.py under a size limit. Shape anchors passed 30/30 tests, but journey canaries still failed after one rubric revision, so the prompt loop was exited per plan section 8. The text does not say who will use this or what the business purpose is.
reading.opinion_reason: The description uses unexplained project-specific terms and references (FR-990, CAP, journeys.yaml, shape anchors, journey canaries, rubric revision, plan section 8) that prevent determining whether the changes are correct or complete without external context.
